Text.Text: Housing such a majestic Creature here attracts many visitors from far shores. Just look at it.. wiggling with his fins. "Meb Meb." (Alt-Dolphin-Pack) Thank you for playing with my mod. I hope you are having fun so far. Big ♥ for you.
"Meb Meb!" The Dolphin seems to like Ornaments. Maybe we should place some on the Island? (200 Ornaments)
